userDirectedTransfers: stream requests to user-provided content servers
privacyLabelPreparation: RevenueCat SDK 5.92.0 manifest: Purchase History for App Functionality, not linked to identity and not used for tracking. This integration uses anonymous IDs only, no login, customer attributes, IDFA, IDFV collection, attribution or third-party integrations. Confirm this declaration in App Store Connect after owner approves RevenueCat connection. See https://www.revenuecat.com/docs/platform-resources/apple-platform-resources/apple-app-privacy

purchaseProcessor.name: RevenueCat
purchaseProcessor.enabledWhen: MIRIVO_REVENUECAT_API_KEY contains an Apple public SDK key

firebase.enabledWhen: GoogleService-Info.plist is bundled and Firebase services are activated
firebase.retention: Opt-out unregisters APNs locally and removes the topic subscription after FCM acknowledgement; unsuccessful removal is retried. Removing the topic subscription does not delete the Firebase installation ID.
firebase.releaseGate: Review Firebase SDK privacy manifests and update App Store Connect privacy answers before upload; live portal declarations have not been changed.

analytics.enabledWhen: Explicit Usage analytics preference; off by default
analytics.portalVerification: Analytics reports and consent behavior require verification with the configured Firebase project

optionalRegistry.enabledWhen: MIRIVO_NOTIFICATION_REGISTRATION_MODE=registry and the server is deployed (not activated in the current Spark project)
optionalRegistry.retention: Opt-out deletes the token and metadata on server acknowledgement. Revision records and inactive registrations expire after 180 days with Firestore TTL enabled; expired records are excluded from sends even before deletion.
